question: What collective domain encompasses all earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: They form a complete field group
inference: All earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs together constitute the complete field group.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of sarvakṣetrakam as a standalone nominative in this fragmentary verse is somewhat elliptical.
plain_english: This is the complete field group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
